app.name: MedRemind
app.tagline: Accessible Medicine & Health Assistant for Elderly Users
app.disclaimer: This is a medication management tool, NOT a diagnostic system or emergency medical dispatch.

dashboard.noNextDose: No upcoming medicines for today. Well done!
dashboard.snoozeSuccess: We will remind you again in 15 minutes.
dashboard.missSuccess: Recorded as missed. Please do not take an extra dose without doctor advice.

medicines.title: Your Medication List
medicines.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. 15 minutes after breakfast with warm water
medicines.isPrn: As-needed medicine only (take only when symptomatic)

history.title: Dose History & Audit
history.subtitle: Review previous doses and correct accidental entries

caregivers.title: Family Caregivers
caregivers.subtitle: Allow trusted family members to monitor and assist
caregivers.name: Caregiver Name
caregivers.permView: Can view medicine schedules and status
caregivers.permAlerts: Can receive alerts if dose is missed
caregivers.revokeConfirm: Are you sure you want to revoke caregiver access immediately?

prescriptions.title: Prescription Scanner (OCR)
prescriptions.subtitle: Snap a photo or upload prescription document
prescriptions.uploadPrompt: Take photo or select file (JPG, PNG, PDF)
prescriptions.ocrDisclaimer: Important: Automated scanner may contain errors. You must verify all medication names and doses before saving!

emergency.title: Emergency Assistance (SOS)
emergency.subtitle: Fast one-tap contact during distress
emergency.sosConfirmTitle: Do you want to call your emergency contact?
emergency.sosConfirmDesc: This opens your phone dialer. You will need to press Call on your phone screen.
emergency.disclaimer: Warning: This does not replace government emergency services (112 / 108). In acute life threats call 112 immediately.

voice.speakPrompt: Try saying: 'When is my next medicine?' or 'Tell me today's medicines'
voice.commandNotRecognized: Sorry, could not understand clearly. Please speak again.
voice.noDoseSpoken: You have no remaining medicines for today.
